scripts.generate: npm run generate:node && npm run generate:python
scripts.generate:node: rimraf packages/node/src/generated && openapi-generator-cli generate -i spec/openapi.yaml -g typescript-fetch -o packages/node/src/generated --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,typescriptThreePlus=true
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm --prefix packages/node run build && python -m build packages/python
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/node test && python -m pytest packages/python/tests
